evidence.issuer: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
evidence.locator: Transfer of ownership on death of owner
evidence.passage: Pay appropriate fee and tax as specified in rule 81 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989

procedure_title: Put a vehicle in your name after the owner has died
statement: Pay the fee and tax set by rule 81 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules. The source does not state the amount.
step_action: Apply at the transport office and pay the fee.
